# 設定のタブ（外枠が窓全体を覆う）・設定を変える・設定のタブの場所でページを開く
chrome settings
chrome set bookmarks_bar 0
chrome set search google
chrome set startup nope
chrome act nothing
chrome reload
chrome bookmark
chrome newtab
chrome settings
chrome go a b
chrome go jw://settings
chrome set bookmarks_bar 1
chrome close -1
close
